headline_pain: Need a Shed AND an Office?
primary_text: "I need warehouse space with a proper office attached — hard to find that as a package." You're not asking for something unusual. You just want what most industrial properties fail to deliver: a real office alongside a real warehouse. Over a dozen businesses have already secured new Truganina warehouses with built-in office space for exactly this reason. High-clearance warehouse floor, integrated mezzanine or ground-level office, kitchenette, and bathroom — all under one title. These off-the-plan units are on the Princes Freeway corridor with pricing built for owner-occupiers. View the floor plans and see how other buyers configured theirs.
